description: Annual NASS survey statistics — yield, production, planted or harvested area — for a commodity at national or state level, from USDA NASS QuickStats. These are survey estimates, not market prices. Use for production fundamentals; use get_crop_condition or get_crop_progress instead for in-season weekly crop status. Read-only lookup of stored statistics; no API key. Returns every stored period (year) for the requested statistic, most recent first; the stored copy refreshes weekly. Commodity, statistic, and geography are case-insensitive and default to CORN, YIELD, and US.

commodity.description: Commodity (CORN, SOYBEANS, WHEAT, COTTON, SORGHUM, OATS, BARLEY, RICE). Default: CORN

geography.description: US for national, or state code (IA, IL, etc.). Default: US

stat.description: Statistic type (YIELD, PRODUCTION, AREA PLANTED, AREA HARVESTED). Default: YIELD

name: get_crop_stats
